# gitmoap_catalog_check_kinds (Data Source)

Describe every derived check the platform implements. The catalogue a scorecard editor offers: each check the platform computes for itself, with its key, label, description, what it depends on, and the form fields and schema for configuring it. The same for every caller.

The token needs `catalog:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `kinds` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds))

<a id="nestedatt--kinds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the check means, and the one thing to do about a failure.
- `fields` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kinds--fields))
- `invalidated_by` (List of String) The kinds of activity that can change this check's answer, causing it to be re-evaluated.
- `key` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `requires` (List of String) The facts this check needs. A service with none of them is `not_applicable`.
- `sweeps` (Boolean) Whether this check is re-evaluated periodically as well as on activity — true for checks
whose answer can change with time alone.

<a id="nestedatt--kinds--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kinds.fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `label` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `required` (Boolean)
